summary: The branch satisfies the agreed decisions. In index.html, a new min-width:1025px block lets the header actions and the separate #wb-save-sync-row wrap, and truncates #current-file, #wb-crumb and #wb-cloud-where with an ellipsis. A 1025–1600px block tightens only the button padding and gaps. No button is hidden, moved into a menu or reduced to an icon, and every label keeps its text. The ≤1024px rules, the shared nav and the other eight pages are untouched. FEATURES.md and the in-file comments describe the new behaviour, and the task-01 row.js assertions were narrowed to ≤1024px so they match the new desktop wrap. This review reran the checks itself, because earlier rounds could not launch Chromium. Root `npm test -- tests/02-adapt-the-menu-for-small-screens/` passed 70/70, matching the retained browser-verification-report.json (70 expected, 0 skipped, unexpected or flaky). Those cases cover 1025, 1280, 1366, 1440, 1536, 1600, 1601 and 1920px in RO and EN, in the worst case the owner agreed: Google connected so the button reads 'Sincronizează acum'/'Sync now', a long status line, the 🗺 Map button shown, a long chapter name and the workbook crumb. They assert no horizontal overflow on the header, the save row, the toolbar or the document; every control inside the viewport; unclipped labels; metadata truncated by ellipsis; pointer hits; Tab order; and the mobile strip at 1024px and below. The header preset passed: verify, gdsync, wbsaveall, gantt, task-01 row and task-03 buttons are OK. idea and nav fail only on their documented baseline checks, which also fail on main. The 1025px RO screenshot shows all controls visible on wrapped rows. The tester report's commit blocker is historical: commit dbb38e2 holds the tests and artifacts, and the working tree was clean.
